"""Original native evidence beside explicit Sampling targets.

TokenJunkieLabs. Frozen scientific sources support analyst-authored sampling
questions. This adapter computes no model, information gain or target priority.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from copy import deepcopy
from pathlib import PurePosixPath

from .common import digest, identifier, read_json, verify_file
from .monitoring_common import ContractError, canonical_bytes

SCHEMA = "upstate.monitoring-native-evidence/v1"
FAMILIES = {
    "multivariate_control_outcomes_id": ("control_outcomes", "urn:upstate:multivariate-control-outcomes:"),
    "terrain_conditioning_report_source_id": ("terrain_response", "urn:upstate:terrain-conditioning-report-source:"),
}
LIMITATIONS = [
    "This is retained native-model evidence supporting an analyst-authored sampling question; no information gain, target priority or statistical power is calculated.",
    "The source's modeled support is not established as this station's contributing catchment. Original station, network and catchment assignments are retained without inferring equivalence from names or identifiers.",
    "Annual modeled source-pixel exports to streams are not station concentrations or intake loads. No flow conversion, calibration or annual-to-seasonal allocation is performed.",
    "The exact observed characteristic, fraction, speciation, method and unit remain distinct. A modeled nitrogen, phosphorus or sediment quantity does not establish equivalence to nitrate, dissolved fractions, orthophosphate or suspended-solids measurements.",
    "Several deterministic control placements or terrain variants are sensitivity evidence, not independent observed replicates, probabilities or confidence intervals.",
]


def normalize(value):
    if not isinstance(value, dict) or set(value) != {
            "source_collection_id", "source_id", "pollutant", "applicability"}:
        raise ContractError("Choose one exact native report source, quantity and authored applicability")
    result = {"source_collection_id": identifier(value["source_collection_id"])}
    for key in ("source_id", "pollutant", "applicability"):
        text = value.get(key)
        if not isinstance(text, str) or not text.strip() or len(text) > (20000 if key == "applicability" else 300):
            raise ContractError("Retain the exact native evidence " + key)
        result[key] = text if key == "source_id" else text.strip()
    if _name(result["source_id"]) != result["source_id"] or "/" in result["source_id"]:
        raise ContractError("Retain a portable original source entry ID")
    return result


def _name(value):
    if not isinstance(value, str):
        raise ContractError("A native evidence member needs its original relative name")
    path = PurePosixPath(value)
    if (path.is_absolute() or not path.parts or str(path) != value
            or ".." in path.parts or "\\" in value or "\0" in value):
        raise ContractError("A native evidence source member is not portable")
    return value


def _document(workspace, collection_id, source_id):
    collection = workspace._get("sources", identifier(collection_id))
    entries = [e for e in collection["entries"] if e["id"] == source_id]
    if len(entries) != 1:
        raise ContractError("Choose an exact retained native evidence entry")
    entry = entries[0]
    if entry.get("kind") != "document" or entry.get("role") != "OBSERVED_CONTEXT":
        raise ContractError("Native evidence must be an original scientific report document")
    metadata = entry.get("metadata", {})
    if not isinstance(metadata, dict):
        raise ContractError("The selected native evidence needs original typed source metadata")
    families = [(key, spec) for key, spec in FAMILIES.items() if key in metadata]
    if len(families) != 1 or metadata.get("report_schema") != "upstate.observed-report/v1":
        raise ContractError("Choose a supported completed native outcome or terrain report")
    key, (family, prefix) = families[0]
    native_id = identifier(metadata[key])
    if entry.get("uri") != prefix + native_id:
        raise ContractError("The native report URI differs from its retained identity")
    bodies, paths = {}, {}
    companions = entry.get("companions", [])
    if not isinstance(entry.get("body"), dict) or not isinstance(companions, list) or any(not isinstance(v, dict) for v in companions):
        raise ContractError("The native evidence source needs complete body and companion descriptors")
    for body in [entry["body"], *companions]:
        name = _name(body.get("view_path", body["filename"]))
        if name in bodies:
            raise ContractError("The native scientific source repeats an original member")
        bodies[name] = deepcopy(body)
        paths[name] = verify_file(workspace.root, {**body, "path": body["object"]})
    recipe = read_json(paths[_name(entry["body"].get("view_path", entry["body"]["filename"]))])
    if recipe.get("schema") != "upstate.observed-report/v1":
        raise ContractError("The original report recipe has an unsupported schema")
    expected = {}
    for member in recipe.get("inputs", []):
        name = _name(member["path"])
        if name in expected:
            raise ContractError("The native recipe repeats an original companion")
        expected[name] = (member["bytes"], member["sha256"])
    actual = {_name(body.get("view_path", body["filename"])): (body["bytes"], body["sha256"])
              for body in entry.get("companions", [])}
    if expected != actual:
        raise ContractError("The complete native evidence companion inventory differs from its recipe")
    if recipe.get("project_id") != metadata.get("project_id"):
        raise ContractError("The native evidence project differs from its original source")
    source = {"collection_id": collection_id, "source_id": source_id,
              "collection_sha256": digest(collection), "entry_sha256": digest(entry),
              "body": deepcopy(entry["body"]), "members": deepcopy(entry.get("companions", [])),
              "title": entry.get("title", source_id), "uri": entry["uri"],
              "classification": deepcopy(metadata.get("classification"))}
    return collection, entry, paths, source, family, native_id, recipe


def _json(paths, name):
    if name not in paths:
        raise ContractError("Retain the native evidence companion " + name)
    return read_json(paths[name])


def _native(workspace, entry, paths, family, native_id, recipe):
    metadata = entry["metadata"]
    project_id = metadata["project_id"]
    local = project_id == workspace.project["id"]
    if family == "control_outcomes":
        value = _json(paths, "assessment.json")
        if (value.get("schema") != "upstate.multivariate-control-outcomes/v1"
                or value.get("id") != native_id or value.get("state") != "complete"
                or digest(value["identity"]) != native_id
                or value["identity"]["project_id"] != project_id
                or value["selection"] != value["identity"]["selection"]
                or value["binding"] != value["identity"]["binding"]
                or _json(paths, "selection.json") != value["selection"]
                or _json(paths, "input-binding.json") != value["binding"]):
            raise ContractError("The completed outcome evidence changed its original identity")
        if local:
            from . import multivariate_control_outcomes as original
            retained = original.inspect(workspace, native_id)
            if any(retained.get(k) != v for k, v in value.items()):
                raise ContractError("The selected report differs from its original native outcome")
        pollutants = value["selection"]["pollutants"]
        units = {}
        for region in value["regions"]:
            for pollutant, row in region["siting_contrasts"].items():
                if pollutant in units and units[pollutant] != row["units"]:
                    raise ContractError("One original native quantity has inconsistent annual units")
                units[pollutant] = row["units"]
        if set(units) != set(pollutants):
            raise ContractError("The native outcome evidence lost a selected quantity")
        classifications = []
        for member in value["binding"]["members"]:
            design = _json(paths, "originals/" + member["design_id"] + "/design.json")
            if (design.get("id") != member["design_id"]
                    or digest(design["identity"]) != member["design_id"]
                    or design["binding"] != design["identity"]["binding"]
                    or design["selection"] != member["selection"]):
                raise ContractError("The original design-source classification lost its retained identity")
            classifications.append({"design_id": member["design_id"],
                "selection": deepcopy(member["selection"]),
                "grid_sources": deepcopy(design["binding"]["grid_sources"]),
                "external_covariates": deepcopy(design["binding"]["external_covariates"]),
                "grid_inputs": deepcopy(design["binding"]["grid_inputs"]),
                "exclusion_source": deepcopy(design["binding"]["exclusion_source"])})
        result = {"family": family, "id": native_id, "project_id": project_id,
            "quantity_scope": value["selection"]["quantity_scope"],
            "quantities": [{"pollutant": p, "units": units[p]} for p in pollutants],
            "run_ids": list(value["binding"]["runs"]),
            "grid_id": value["binding"]["grid_id"], "profile_id": value["binding"]["profile_id"],
            "geometry": deepcopy(value["binding"]["grid_files"]),
            "rows": deepcopy(value["regions"]), "support": deepcopy(value["summary"]["group_common_support"]),
            "placements": deepcopy(value["placements"]),
            "placement_overlaps": deepcopy(value["placement_overlaps"]),
            "native_execution": deepcopy(value["binding"]["native_execution"]),
            "classification": deepcopy(metadata.get("classification")),
            "original_input_classifications": classifications,
            "source_project_relation": "same_project" if local else "retained_foreign_source"}
    else:
        selection = _json(paths, "selection.json")
        raw = {k: v for k, v in selection.items() if k != "id"}
        binding = _json(paths, "input-binding.json")
        value = _json(paths, "original-native-response.json")
        if (selection.get("schema") != "upstate.terrain-conditioning-report-sources/v1"
                or selection.get("id") != native_id or digest(raw) != native_id
                or selection.get("project_id") != project_id or selection.get("binding") != binding
                or value.get("schema") != "upstate.terrain-native-response/v1"
                or value.get("state") != "complete"
                or selection["response_id"] != value["id"]
                or selection["case_id"] != value["selection"]["case_id"]
                or metadata.get("terrain_conditioning_response_id") != value["id"]
                or metadata.get("terrain_conditioning_case_id") != selection["case_id"]
                or binding["response_id"] != value["id"] or binding["project_id"] != project_id):
            raise ContractError("The terrain evidence differs from its original completed response")
        if local:
            from . import terrain_conditioning_report_source as original
            retained = original.inspect(workspace, native_id)
            if retained.get("state") != "complete" or retained["selection"] != selection or retained["binding"] != binding:
                raise ContractError("The selected source differs from its original native terrain report")
        units = {}
        for row in value["rows"]:
            p = row["metric"]
            if p in units and units[p] != row["units"]:
                raise ContractError("One terrain quantity has inconsistent annual units")
            units[p] = row["units"]
        if set(units) != set(binding["quantity_support"]):
            raise ContractError("The original terrain report lost its complete quantity support")
        result = {"family": family, "id": native_id, "response_id": value["id"],
            "case_id": selection["case_id"], "project_id": project_id,
            "quantity_scope": "original_terrain_joint_native_support",
            "quantities": [{"pollutant": p, "units": units[p]} for p in units],
            "run_ids": [binding["baseline_run_id"], *[r["run_id"] for r in binding["alternatives"]]],
            "geometry": deepcopy(binding["case"]),
            "rows": deepcopy(value["rows"]), "support": deepcopy(binding["quantity_support"]),
            "native_execution": deepcopy(binding["native_versions"]),
            "classification": deepcopy(binding.get("source_classification")),
            "original_input_classifications": deepcopy(binding["original_source_records"]),
            "source_project_relation": "same_project" if local else "retained_foreign_source"}
    result["report_title"] = recipe.get("title", entry.get("title"))
    return result


def describe(workspace, collection_id, source_id):
    collection, entry, paths, source, family, native_id, recipe = _document(
        workspace, collection_id, source_id)
    native = _native(workspace, entry, paths, family, native_id, recipe)
    return {"source": source, "native": native}


def catalog(workspace):
    choices, issues = [], []
    for path in sorted((workspace.root / "sources").glob("*.json")):
        try:
            collection = workspace._get("sources", path.stem)
        except (ValueError, KeyError, OSError, TypeError) as error:
            issues.append({"source_collection_id": path.stem, "message": str(error)})
            continue
        for entry in collection.get("entries", []):
            metadata = entry.get("metadata", {})
            if (entry.get("kind") != "document" or entry.get("role") != "OBSERVED_CONTEXT"
                    or not isinstance(metadata, dict) or not any(k in metadata for k in FAMILIES)):
                continue
            try:
                value = describe(workspace, collection["id"], entry["id"])
                native = value["native"]
                choices.append({"source_collection_id": collection["id"], "source_id": entry["id"],
                    "title": entry.get("title", entry["id"]), "family": native["family"],
                    "project_id": native["project_id"], "native_id": native["id"],
                    "quantities": native["quantities"], "support_scope": native["quantity_scope"],
                    "classification": native["classification"],
                    "source_project_relation": native["source_project_relation"]})
            except (ValueError, KeyError, OSError, ImportError, TypeError) as error:
                issues.append({"source_collection_id": collection["id"], "source_id": entry["id"],
                               "message": str(error)})
    return {"schema": SCHEMA, "choices": choices, "issues": issues, "limitations": LIMITATIONS}


def resolve(workspace, record, selection):
    from .monitoring_recommendations import _context_view
    view = _context_view(record)
    stations = {row["source_station_id"]: row for row in view["stations"]}
    cohorts = {row["id"]: row for row in view["cohorts"]}
    results, cache = {}, {}
    for target in selection["targets"]:
        if "model_evidence" not in target:
            continue
        chosen = normalize(target["model_evidence"])
        key = chosen["source_collection_id"], chosen["source_id"]
        if key not in cache:
            cache[key] = describe(workspace, *key)
        value = deepcopy(cache[key])
        native = value["native"]
        quantities = {q["pollutant"]: q for q in native["quantities"]}
        if chosen["pollutant"] not in quantities:
            raise ContractError("Choose a quantity actually present in the exact selected native source")
        pollutant = chosen["pollutant"]
        native["selected_quantity"] = deepcopy(quantities[pollutant])
        native["support"] = deepcopy(native["support"][pollutant])
        if native["family"] == "control_outcomes":
            native["rows"] = [{**r, "siting_contrasts": {pollutant: r["siting_contrasts"][pollutant]},
                              "native_support": {pollutant: r["native_support"][pollutant]}}
                             for r in native["rows"]]
        else:
            native["rows"] = [r for r in native["rows"] if r["metric"] == pollutant]
        value.update(schema=SCHEMA, selection=chosen, applicability=chosen["applicability"],
            target_binding={"context_id": record["id"], "context_digest": digest(record),
                "network_id": record["network_id"], "network_digest": record["network_digest"],
                "station": deepcopy(stations[target["station_id"]]),
                "cohort": deepcopy(cohorts[target["cohort_id"]]),
                "evidence_start": selection["evidence_start"], "evidence_end": selection["evidence_end"],
                "months": deepcopy(target["months"])},
            relation={"spatial": "not_established", "constituent": "analyst_context_only",
                "temporal": "annual_model_vs_selected_observation_window", "quantitative_comparison": False},
            limitations=deepcopy(LIMITATIONS))
        results[target["id"]] = value
    return results


def export_members(workspace, records):
    from .monitoring_packet import bytes_member, file_member
    seen = set()
    for record in records:
        for target in record["targets"]:
            value = target.get("model_evidence")
            if value is None:
                continue
            source = value["source"]
            key = source["collection_id"], source["source_id"]
            if key in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(key)
            collection, entry, paths, current, _, _, _ = _document(workspace, *key)
            if current != source:
                raise ContractError("The exact saved target evidence changed before export")
            prefix = "native-evidence/" + key[0] + "/" + key[1] + "/"
            yield prefix + "source-edition.json", bytes_member(canonical_bytes(collection))
            yield prefix + "source-entry.json", bytes_member(canonical_bytes(entry))
            for body in [entry["body"], *entry.get("companions", [])]:
                name = _name(body.get("view_path", body["filename"]))
                yield prefix + name, file_member(paths[name], body["bytes"], body["sha256"])


def include(closure, proposal):
    """Original Study resolver owns source objects and all local native histories."""
    for target in proposal.get("targets", []):
        value = target.get("model_evidence")
        if value is None:
            continue
        source = value["source"]
        collection_id, source_id = source["collection_id"], source["source_id"]
        closure.need("sources", collection_id, "Original sampling target native evidence")
        if value["native"]["project_id"] == closure.workspace.project["id"]:
            kind = ("multivariate-control-outcomes" if value["native"]["family"] == "control_outcomes"
                    else "terrain-conditioning-report-sources")
            closure.need(kind, value["native"]["id"],
                         "Complete original native evidence for an explicit sampling target")

"""Typed Monitoring study dependencies for the original editable archive.

Original Workspace records, campaign replay identities and source objects stay
authoritative. Selection composes model.study_transfer; it creates no parallel
store, fieldwork scheduler or archive format.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import copy

from .common import canonical, digest, identifier, read_json

ROOT_KINDS = ("monitoring_networks", "monitoring_plans", "monitoring_frontiers",
              "monitoring_heads", "monitoring_observed_contexts",
              "monitoring_frontier_comparisons", "monitoring_recommendations",
              "monitoring_recommendation_designs")
IMMUTABLE_KINDS = ("monitoring_networks", "monitoring_plans", "monitoring_frontiers",
                   "monitoring_revisions", "monitoring_events",
                   "monitoring_observed_contexts", "monitoring_frontier_comparisons",
                   "monitoring_recommendations", "monitoring_recommendation_designs")
MUTABLE_KINDS = ("monitoring_heads", "monitoring_frontier_jobs")
DOCUMENTS = {"monitoring-report-sources": "report.json"}
LABELS = {
    "monitoring_networks": "Monitoring networks",
    "monitoring_plans": "Monitoring designs",
    "monitoring_frontiers": "Monitoring budget frontiers",
    "monitoring_frontier_comparisons": "Saved Monitoring budget choices",
    "monitoring_recommendations": "Sampling priorities and proposal history",
    "monitoring_recommendation_designs": "Sampling priority native designs",
    "monitoring_heads": "Editable monitoring campaigns",
    "monitoring_revisions": "Monitoring campaign revisions",
    "monitoring_events": "Monitoring field events",
    "monitoring_observed_contexts": "Monitoring observational context",
    "monitoring_frontier_jobs": "Monitoring budget continuation",
    "monitoring-report-sources": "Monitoring report sources",
}


def _native(closure, kind, key):
    """Read and hash an original immutable record, without changing Workspace."""
    key = identifier(key)
    value = closure.read(kind + "/" + key + ".json")
    if value.get("schema") != "upstate." + kind + "/v1" or digest(value) != key:
        raise ValueError("The original Monitoring record changed: " + kind + "/" + key)
    return {**value, "id": key}


def _binding(closure, binding, reason):
    if not isinstance(binding, dict):
        raise ValueError("Monitoring needs its original source binding.")
    key = binding.get("source_collection_id") or binding.get("source_record_id")
    closure.need("sources", key, reason)
    from .monitoring_sources import verify_retained_binding
    verify_retained_binding(closure.workspace, binding)


def _bindings(closure, bindings, reason):
    if not isinstance(bindings, dict):
        raise ValueError("Monitoring source bindings must retain their original mapping.")
    for binding in bindings.values():
        if binding:
            _binding(closure, binding, reason)


def _plan_network(closure, value, reason):
    plan = _native(closure, "monitoring_plans", value["plan_id"])
    if plan["network_id"] != value["network_id"]:
        raise ValueError("Monitoring history points to a different source network.")
    closure.need("monitoring_plans", plan["id"], reason)
    closure.need("monitoring_networks", value["network_id"], reason)
    return plan


def _campaign(closure, key, head):
    if (head.get("campaign_id") != key or not isinstance(head.get("operations"), dict)):
        raise ValueError("The Monitoring campaign head changed its original identity.")
    identifier(head.get("revision_id"))
    seen, records = set(), []
    current = head["revision_id"]
    expected_number = None
    while current is not None:
        if current in seen:
            raise ValueError("Monitoring campaign history contains a revision cycle.")
        seen.add(current)
        revision = _native(closure, "monitoring_revisions", current)
        number = revision.get("revision")
        if (revision.get("campaign_id") != key or type(number) is not int or number < 1
                or (expected_number is not None and number != expected_number)):
            raise ValueError("Monitoring campaign history changed its revision sequence.")
        closure.need("monitoring_revisions", current, "Complete selected campaign history")
        records.append(revision)
        expected_number = number - 1
        current = revision.get("parent_id")
        if current is None and number != 1:
            raise ValueError("Monitoring campaign history lost its first revision.")
    if digest({"monitoring_campaign_creation": records[-1].get("operation_id")}) != key:
        raise ValueError("The Monitoring campaign changed its original creation operation.")
    by_id = {record["id"]: record for record in records}
    for operation_id, operation in head["operations"].items():
        if (not isinstance(operation_id, str) or not operation_id
                or not isinstance(operation, dict)
                or set(operation) != {"fingerprint", "revision_id"}):
            raise ValueError("The original campaign replay operation is unreadable.")
        identifier(operation["fingerprint"])
        record = by_id.get(operation["revision_id"])
        if record is None or record.get("operation_id") != operation_id:
            raise ValueError("Campaign replay no longer names its original revision.")
    for record in records:
        operation = head["operations"].get(record.get("operation_id"))
        if not operation or operation["revision_id"] != record["id"]:
            raise ValueError("Campaign history lost an original replay identity.")
    closure.monitoring_records[("monitoring_heads", key)] = {
        "kind": "monitoring_heads", "id": key, "head": copy.deepcopy(head),
        "revisions": [record["id"] for record in reversed(records)],
    }
    closure.nodes[("monitoring_heads", key)].update(
        title=records[0].get("title") or key[:12], state="saved",
        revisions=len(records), revision_id=head["revision_id"])


def _frontier_job(closure, key, head):
    if (head.get("job_id") != key or not isinstance(head.get("completed"), dict)):
        raise ValueError("Monitoring budget continuation changed its original identity.")
    for budget, plan_id in head["completed"].items():
        if (not isinstance(budget, str) or not budget.isdecimal()
                or str(int(budget)) != budget):
            raise ValueError("Monitoring budget continuation needs an exact original budget.")
        plan = _native(closure, "monitoring_plans", plan_id)
        if plan.get("frontier_job_id") != key or plan.get("frontier_budget_cents") != int(budget):
            raise ValueError("Monitoring budget continuation points to another saved design.")
        closure.need("monitoring_plans", plan_id, "Retained budget-comparison continuation")
    closure.monitoring_records[("monitoring_frontier_jobs", key)] = {
        "kind": "monitoring_frontier_jobs", "id": key, "head": copy.deepcopy(head),
    }


def _inspect_report(closure, key, value):
    """Keep native verification while admitting its exact source-view hardlinks.

    The original producer verifies its retained recipe by materializing source
    views. A cold restored Workspace has none. Only those declared CAS inodes
    may change ctime here, and their original bytes and stable identity must
    match before and after that owned operation.
    """
    from .common import file_digest
    from .monitoring_report_source import inspect
    from .study_transfer import _identity, _member, _stable_data_identity

    choice = value["source"]
    collection = _native(closure, "sources", choice["source_collection_id"])
    entries = [entry for entry in collection["entries"] if entry["id"] == choice["source_id"]]
    if len(entries) != 1:
        raise ValueError("The Monitoring report lost its exact original source entry.")
    entry = entries[0]
    declared = {}
    for descriptor in [entry["body"]] + entry.get("companions", []):
        path = _member(closure.root, descriptor["object"])
        before = _identity(path)
        checksum = identifier(descriptor["sha256"])
        if before[2] != descriptor["bytes"] or file_digest(path) != checksum or _identity(path) != before:
            raise ValueError("The original Monitoring report source changed before verification.")
        token = before[:2]
        previous = declared.get(token)
        if previous is not None and previous["sha256"] != checksum:
            raise ValueError("Monitoring report source references disagree about one original inode.")
        declared[token] = {"identity": before, "sha256": checksum,
                           "links": path.stat().st_nlink}
    retained = {}
    for relative, item in closure.files.items():
        original = declared.get(item["identity"][:2])
        if original is None:
            continue
        path = _member(closure.root, relative)
        if (_identity(path) != item["identity"]
                or _stable_data_identity(item["identity"]) != _stable_data_identity(original["identity"])
                or item.get("sha256", original["sha256"]) != original["sha256"]):
            raise ValueError("The selected Monitoring source changed before native verification.")
        retained[relative] = original

    record = inspect(closure.workspace, key, verify=True)
    for relative, original in retained.items():
        path = _member(closure.root, relative)
        after = _identity(path)
        before = closure.files[relative]["identity"]
        if after == before:
            continue
        if (_stable_data_identity(after) != _stable_data_identity(before)
                or path.stat().st_nlink <= original["links"]
                or file_digest(path) != original["sha256"]
                or _identity(path) != after):
            raise ValueError("The selected Monitoring source changed during native verification.")
        closure.files[relative]["identity"] = after
        closure.files[relative]["sha256"] = original["sha256"]
    return record


def _report(closure, key, value):
    record = _inspect_report(closure, key, value)
    if record != value or record.get("state") != "complete":
        raise ValueError("Select a completed original Monitoring report source.")
    selection = record["selection"]
    if selection.get("plan_id"):
        closure.need("monitoring_plans", selection["plan_id"], "Saved Monitoring report design")
    if selection.get("campaign_id"):
        closure.need("monitoring_heads", selection["campaign_id"], "Editable reported Monitoring campaign")
        closure.need("monitoring_revisions", selection["expected_revision_id"],
                     "Exact reported Monitoring campaign revision")
    prefix = "monitoring-report-sources/" + key
    closure.tree(prefix)
    closure._descriptors(record["files"])
    closure._source_refs(record["source"], "Retained original Monitoring report source")
    if selection.get("comparison_id"):
        comparison_id = identifier(selection["comparison_id"])
        comparison = _native(closure, "monitoring_frontier_comparisons", comparison_id)
        expected = {
            "comparison_id": comparison_id,
            "frontier_id": comparison["frontier_id"],
            "network_id": comparison["network_id"],
            "plan_ids": comparison["plan_ids"],
            "context_ids": comparison["selection"]["context_ids"],
        }
        if closure.read(prefix + "/comparison-records.json") != expected:
            raise ValueError("The Monitoring report changed its exact saved budget choices.")
        closure.need("monitoring_frontier_comparisons", comparison_id,
                     "Editable original budget comparison behind the retained report")
    else:
        for row in closure.read(prefix + "/history-records.json"):
            kind = {"plans": "monitoring_plans", "networks": "monitoring_networks",
                    "revisions": "monitoring_revisions", "events": "monitoring_events"}.get(row.get("kind"))
            if kind is None:
                raise ValueError("A Monitoring report has an unknown original history kind.")
            closure.need(kind, row["id"], "Original reported Monitoring history")
    closure.monitoring_reports[key] = {
        "id": key, "record_sha256": record["record_sha256"],
        "source": copy.deepcopy(record["source"]),
    }


def include_source(closure, collection_id, entry):
    """Follow one explicitly ordered original Monitoring report source.

    Scientific report edition transfer calls this for its actual chosen source.
    Foreign project reports keep their contained CAS and original provenance;
    local producer identities must resolve to their complete editable history.
    """
    from . import observed_context
    if (entry.get("id") != "monitoring-design-and-field-history"
            or entry.get("role") != "monitoring-report-source"):
        return False
    recipe = closure.read(entry["body"]["object"])
    if (recipe.get("schema") != observed_context.SCHEMA
            or recipe.get("report_context_kind") not in {
                "monitoring-design-and-field-history", "monitoring-budget-comparison"}):
        raise ValueError("The selected Monitoring report lost its original recipe contract.")
    project_id = recipe.get("project_id")
    if not isinstance(project_id, str) or not project_id:
        raise ValueError("The selected Monitoring report lost its declared original project.")
    prefix = "urn:upstate:monitoring-report:" + project_id + ":"
    uri = entry.get("uri")
    if not isinstance(uri, str) or not uri.startswith(prefix):
        raise ValueError("The selected Monitoring report changed its original producer identity.")
    key = identifier(uri[len(prefix):])
    if project_id != closure.workspace.project["id"]:
        return False
    path = "monitoring-report-sources/" + key + "/report.json"
    report = closure.read(path)
    expected = {"source_collection_id": identifier(collection_id), "source_id": entry["id"]}
    if report.get("source") != expected:
        raise ValueError("The local Monitoring producer names another original source edition.")
    expected_kind = ("monitoring-budget-comparison" if report.get("selection", {}).get("comparison_id")
                     else "monitoring-design-and-field-history")
    if recipe["report_context_kind"] != expected_kind:
        raise ValueError("The Monitoring source recipe differs from its native report selection.")
    closure.need("monitoring-report-sources", key,
                 "Editable history of the explicitly ordered Monitoring report")
    return True


def _field_return(closure, event):
    """Retain the exact saved fieldwork source behind an original returned event."""
    binding = event.get("values", {}).get("fieldwork_return")
    if binding is None:
        return
    if not isinstance(binding, dict):
        raise ValueError("The Monitoring event lost its original fieldwork return binding.")
    key = identifier(binding.get("request_id"))
    prefix = "monitoring_field_returns/" + key
    # Reuse original request/plan validation within this single closure, while
    # validating every event and retaining the first full file identities.
    cache = getattr(closure, "_monitoring_field_return_cache", None)
    if cache is None:
        cache = {}
        closure._monitoring_field_return_cache = cache
    if (str(closure.workspace.root), key) not in cache:
        for name in ("request.json", "field-plan.json"):
            closure.read(prefix + "/" + name)
    from .monitoring_field_return import source_binding
    retained = source_binding(closure.workspace, event, cache=cache)
    if retained is None or retained["request_id"] != key:
        raise ValueError("The original fieldwork return resolved to another request.")
    expected = {name: str(closure.root / prefix / name)
                for name in ("request.json", "field-plan.json")}
    if retained["source_files"] != expected:
        raise ValueError("The original fieldwork return names another source directory.")
    selection = retained["request"]["selection"]
    closure.need("monitoring_revisions", selection["expected_revision_id"],
                 "Campaign revision reviewed for the original fieldwork return")


def _comparison(closure, key, value):
    """Reopen the original saved choice, preserving its exact immutable inputs."""
    from .monitoring_frontier_comparison import inspect
    inspected = inspect(closure.workspace, key)
    if inspected != {**value, "id": key}:
        raise ValueError("The saved Monitoring budget comparison changed while selected.")
    selection = value["selection"]
    if (selection["frontier_id"] != value["frontier_id"]
            or selection["baseline_plan_id"] != value["baseline_plan_id"]
            or value["baseline_plan_id"] not in value["plan_ids"]):
        raise ValueError("The Monitoring comparison changed its retained baseline choice.")
    closure.need("monitoring_frontiers", value["frontier_id"],
                 "Original completed budget frontier of the saved comparison")
    closure.need("monitoring_networks", value["network_id"],
                 "Original source network of the saved budget comparison")
    for plan_id in value["plan_ids"]:
        closure.need("monitoring_plans", plan_id, "Original compared Monitoring design")
    for context_id in selection["context_ids"]:
        closure.need("monitoring_observed_contexts", context_id,
                     "Exact per-plan observed context of the saved budget comparison")


def _recommendation(closure, kind, key, value):
    """Carry original observations, ancestry and solver results in one study.

    Operation indices are a local derived cache. Immutable request identities
    travel with the selected records and rebuild that cache on an exact retry.
    """
    from . import monitoring_recommendations as recommendations

    reason = "Original source-bound sampling priorities"
    if kind == "monitoring_recommendations":
        inspected = recommendations.inspect(closure.workspace, key)
        if inspected != {**value, "id": key}:
            raise ValueError("The sampling proposal changed while selected.")
        closure.need("monitoring_observed_contexts", value["context_id"], reason)
        closure.need("monitoring_networks", value["network_id"], reason)
        closure.need("sources", value["source_binding"]["source_collection_id"], reason)
        if any("model_evidence" in row for row in value.get("targets", [])):
            from . import monitoring_native_evidence
            monitoring_native_evidence.include(closure, value)
        revision = value.get("revision")
        if type(revision) is not int or revision < 1:
            raise ValueError("The sampling proposal lost its original revision number.")
        parent_id = value.get("parent_id")
        if parent_id:
            parent = _native(closure, kind, parent_id)
            if (parent.get("context_id") != value["context_id"]
                    or type(parent.get("revision")) is not int
                    or parent["revision"] + 1 != revision):
                raise ValueError("The sampling proposal changed its original ancestry.")
            closure.need(kind, parent_id, "Complete selected sampling proposal history")
        elif revision != 1:
            raise ValueError("The sampling proposal lost its first edition.")
        closure.nodes[(kind, key)].update(
            state="saved", revision=revision, context_id=value["context_id"])
    else:
        inspected = recommendations.inspect_design(closure.workspace, key)
        if inspected != {**value, "id": key}:
            raise ValueError("The sampling design handoff changed while selected.")
        closure.need("monitoring_recommendations", value["recommendation_id"], reason)
        closure.need("monitoring_observed_contexts", value["context_id"], reason)
        closure.need("monitoring_networks", value["network_id"], reason)
        closure.need("monitoring_plans", value["plan_id"],
                     "Original native design requested by the sampling proposal")
        closure.nodes[(kind, key)].update(
            state=value.get("status"), plan_id=value["plan_id"])


def visit(closure, kind, key, value):
    if kind not in LABELS:
        return False
    if kind == "monitoring_heads":
        _campaign(closure, key, value)
        return True
    if kind == "monitoring_frontier_jobs":
        _frontier_job(closure, key, value)
        return True
    if kind == "monitoring-report-sources":
        _report(closure, key, value)
        return True
    if value.get("schema") != "upstate." + kind + "/v1" or digest(value) != key:
        raise ValueError("The original Monitoring record changed: " + kind + "/" + key)
    reason = "Original " + LABELS[kind].lower()
    if kind in {"monitoring_recommendations", "monitoring_recommendation_designs"}:
        _recommendation(closure, kind, key, value)
    elif kind == "monitoring_frontier_comparisons":
        _comparison(closure, key, value)
    elif kind == "monitoring_networks":
        _bindings(closure, value["source_bindings"], reason)
    elif kind == "monitoring_plans":
        if value.get("recommendation_id"):
            recommendation = _native(closure, "monitoring_recommendations", value["recommendation_id"])
            if recommendation["network_id"] != value["network_id"]:
                raise ValueError("The native sampling design names another original network.")
            closure.need("monitoring_recommendations", recommendation["id"],
                         "Source-bound sampling priorities behind the original native design")
        closure.need("monitoring_networks", value["network_id"], reason)
        _bindings(closure, value["source_bindings"], reason)
        job_id = value.get("frontier_job_id")
        if job_id and closure.exists("monitoring_frontier_jobs", job_id):
            closure.need("monitoring_frontier_jobs", job_id, "Saved budget-comparison progress")
    elif kind == "monitoring_frontiers":
        closure.need("monitoring_networks", value["network_id"], reason)
        for plan_id in value["plan_ids"]:
            plan = _native(closure, "monitoring_plans", plan_id)
            if plan["network_id"] != value["network_id"] or plan.get("frontier_job_id") != value["job_id"]:
                raise ValueError("Monitoring comparison mixes different original budget programmes.")
            closure.need("monitoring_plans", plan_id, reason)
        if closure.exists("monitoring_frontier_jobs", value["job_id"]):
            closure.need("monitoring_frontier_jobs", value["job_id"], reason)
    elif kind == "monitoring_revisions":
        plan = _plan_network(closure, value, reason)
        parent = value.get("parent_id")
        if parent:
            previous = _native(closure, "monitoring_revisions", parent)
            if (previous["campaign_id"] != value["campaign_id"]
                    or previous["revision"] + 1 != value["revision"]
                    or not set(previous["event_ids"]).issubset(value["event_ids"])):
                raise ValueError("Monitoring revision changed its retained parent or field history.")
            closure.need("monitoring_revisions", parent, reason)
        elif value.get("revision") != 1:
            raise ValueError("Monitoring revision lost its original parent.")
        for event_id in value["event_ids"]:
            event = _native(closure, "monitoring_events", event_id)
            if event["campaign_id"] != value["campaign_id"]:
                raise ValueError("Monitoring revision contains another campaign's field event.")
            closure.need("monitoring_events", event_id, reason)
    elif kind == "monitoring_events":
        _plan_network(closure, value, reason)
        _bindings(closure, value["source_bindings"], reason)
        _field_return(closure, value)
        if value.get("expected_revision_id"):
            closure.need("monitoring_revisions", value["expected_revision_id"],
                         "Original field-event campaign revision")
    elif kind == "monitoring_observed_contexts":
        from .monitoring_observed_context import inspect
        inspected = inspect(closure.workspace, key)
        if inspected != {**value, "id": key}:
            raise ValueError("The observed Monitoring context changed while selected.")
        closure.need("monitoring_networks", value["network_id"], reason)
        closure.need("sources", value["source_binding"]["source_collection_id"], reason)
        if value.get("plan_id"):
            closure.need("monitoring_plans", value["plan_id"], reason)
        if value.get("campaign_revision_id"):
            closure.need("monitoring_revisions", value["campaign_revision_id"], reason)
        if value.get("campaign_id"):
            closure.need("monitoring_heads", value["campaign_id"], "Editable observed Monitoring campaign")
    return True


def _related_row(closure, path):
    try:
        value = read_json(path)
        if not isinstance(value, dict):
            raise ValueError("The related Monitoring record is not an original object.")
        identifier(path.stem if path.suffix == ".json" and path.name != "report.json" else path.parent.name)
        return value
    except (ValueError, OSError, TypeError) as error:
        closure.related_issues.append({"path": path.relative_to(closure.root).as_posix(),
                                       "message": str(error)})
        return None


def related(closure):
    # Use only the explicitly selected cohort as discovery seeds. A newly added
    # historical network must not pull other campaigns sharing that old source.
    roots = {(row["kind"], row["id"]) for row in closure.selection["roots"]}
    networks = {key for kind, key in roots if kind == "monitoring_networks"}
    plans = {key for kind, key in roots if kind == "monitoring_plans"}
    campaigns = {key for kind, key in closure.nodes if kind == "monitoring_heads"}
    frontiers = {key for kind, key in roots if kind == "monitoring_frontiers"}
    comparisons = {key for kind, key in roots if kind == "monitoring_frontier_comparisons"}
    context_ids = {key for kind, key in roots if kind == "monitoring_observed_contexts"}
    recommendations = {key for kind, key in roots if kind == "monitoring_recommendations"}
    contexts = [closure.read("monitoring_observed_contexts/" + key + ".json")
                for kind, key in roots if kind == "monitoring_observed_contexts"]
    plans.update(row["plan_id"] for row in contexts if row.get("plan_id"))
    for folder in ("monitoring_plans", "monitoring_frontiers"):
        for path in sorted((closure.root / folder).glob("*.json")):
            value = _related_row(closure, path)
            if value is not None and value.get("network_id") in networks:
                closure.need(folder, path.stem, "Saved work on the explicitly selected Monitoring network")
                if folder == "monitoring_plans":
                    plans.add(path.stem)
    # Only explicitly chosen networks/frontiers discover other saved choices.
    # A comparison retains its own exact contexts through the typed visitor;
    # an implicitly reached network does not expand to every later comparison.
    if networks or frontiers:
        for path in sorted((closure.root / "monitoring_frontier_comparisons").glob("*.json")):
            value = _related_row(closure, path)
            if value is not None and (value.get("network_id") in networks
                    or value.get("frontier_id") in frontiers):
                comparisons.add(path.stem)
                closure.need("monitoring_frontier_comparisons", path.stem,
                             "Saved choices on the explicitly selected Monitoring frontier")
    # A selected design carries its editable campaigns. Comparing against the
    # retained current revision avoids matching arbitrary hashes or prose.
    if networks or plans:
        for path in sorted((closure.root / "monitoring_heads").glob("*.json")):
            head = _related_row(closure, path)
            if head is None:
                continue
            try:
                revision = read_json(closure.root / "monitoring_revisions" / (identifier(head["revision_id"]) + ".json"))
            except (KeyError, ValueError, OSError) as error:
                closure.related_issues.append({"path": path.relative_to(closure.root).as_posix(), "message": str(error)})
                continue
            if revision.get("network_id") in networks or revision.get("plan_id") in plans:
                closure.need("monitoring_heads", path.stem, "Editable campaign on the selected Monitoring design")
                campaigns.add(path.stem)
    for path in sorted((closure.root / "monitoring_observed_contexts").glob("*.json")):
        value = _related_row(closure, path)
        if value is not None and (value.get("campaign_id") in campaigns
                or value.get("plan_id") in plans or value.get("network_id") in networks):
            closure.need("monitoring_observed_contexts", path.stem, "Saved observational context for the selected Monitoring study")

    # Discovery follows only explicit roots. Proposal ancestors retain their
    # own inputs but do not pull unrelated descendants or later source work.
    for path in sorted((closure.root / "monitoring_recommendations").glob("*.json")):
        value = _related_row(closure, path)
        if value is not None and (value.get("context_id") in context_ids
                or value.get("network_id") in networks):
            recommendations.add(path.stem)
            closure.need("monitoring_recommendations", path.stem,
                         "Saved sampling priorities for the explicitly selected source")
    for path in sorted((closure.root / "monitoring_recommendation_designs").glob("*.json")):
        value = _related_row(closure, path)
        if value is not None and (value.get("recommendation_id") in recommendations
                or value.get("plan_id") in plans):
            closure.need("monitoring_recommendation_designs", path.stem,
                         "Original native design handoff for the selected sampling study")

    for path in sorted((closure.root / "monitoring-report-sources").glob("*/report.json")):
        value = _related_row(closure, path)
        if value is None or value.get("state") != "complete":
            continue
        selection = value.get("selection", {})
        if (selection.get("campaign_id") in campaigns or selection.get("plan_id") in plans
                or selection.get("comparison_id") in comparisons):
            closure.need("monitoring-report-sources", path.parent.name, "Completed report for the selected Monitoring study")


def lock_paths(closure):
    paths = set()
    if any(kind in LABELS for kind, _ in closure.nodes):
        paths.add("monitoring.lock")
    if any(kind == "monitoring-report-sources" for kind, _ in closure.nodes):
        paths.add(".monitoring-report-source.lock")
    for kind, key in closure.nodes:
        if kind == "monitoring_frontier_jobs":
            paths.add(kind + "/" + key + ".lock")
    return sorted(paths)


def receipt(closure):
    return {
        "campaigns": [copy.deepcopy(row) for (kind, _), row in sorted(closure.monitoring_records.items())
                      if kind == "monitoring_heads"],
        "frontiers": [copy.deepcopy(row) for (kind, _), row in sorted(closure.monitoring_records.items())
                      if kind == "monitoring_frontier_jobs"],
        "reports": [copy.deepcopy(row) for _, row in sorted(closure.monitoring_reports.items())],
    }


def verify_receipt(closure, captured):
    if captured is None:
        return None
    if not isinstance(captured, dict) or set(captured) != {"campaigns", "frontiers", "reports"}:
        raise ValueError("The transferred Monitoring history has an unreadable identity.")
    for row in captured["campaigns"]:
        current = closure.monitoring_records.get(("monitoring_heads", row["id"]))
        if current is None:
            raise ValueError("The received study lost its editable Monitoring campaign.")
        before, after = row["head"], current["head"]
        if ({k: v for k, v in before.items() if k not in {"revision_id", "operations"}}
                != {k: v for k, v in after.items() if k not in {"revision_id", "operations"}}):
            raise ValueError("The received campaign changed its original identity.")
        if current["revisions"][:len(row["revisions"])] != row["revisions"]:
            raise ValueError("The received campaign replaced its retained history.")
        for operation_id, operation in before["operations"].items():
            if after["operations"].get(operation_id) != operation:
                raise ValueError("The received campaign changed an original replay operation.")
    for row in captured["frontiers"]:
        current = closure.monitoring_records.get(("monitoring_frontier_jobs", row["id"]))
        if current is None:
            raise ValueError("The received study lost its budget-comparison continuation.")
        before, after = row["head"], current["head"]
        if ({k: v for k, v in before.items() if k != "completed"}
                != {k: v for k, v in after.items() if k != "completed"}):
            raise ValueError("The received budget comparison changed its original identity.")
        if any(after["completed"].get(key) != value for key, value in before["completed"].items()):
            raise ValueError("The received budget comparison replaced a completed original design.")
    for row in captured["reports"]:
        if closure.monitoring_reports.get(row["id"]) != row:
            raise ValueError("The received Monitoring report source changed.")
    return {"campaigns": len(captured["campaigns"]), "frontiers": len(captured["frontiers"]),
            "reports": len(captured["reports"]), "identity": "MATCH"}


def catalogue(workspace, kind):
    if kind not in ROOT_KINDS:
        raise ValueError("Choose an original Monitoring study kind.")
    rows = []
    for path in sorted((workspace.root / kind).glob("*.json")):
        key = path.stem
        try:
            identifier(key)
            value = read_json(path)
            if kind == "monitoring_heads":
                if value.get("campaign_id") != key:
                    raise ValueError("The campaign head has a different original identity.")
                record = workspace._get("monitoring_revisions", value["revision_id"])
                title, state = record.get("title"), "saved"
                selection = {"campaign_id": key, "revision_id": record["id"],
                             "plan_id": record["plan_id"], "network_id": record["network_id"]}
            else:
                record = workspace._get(kind, key)
                title, state = record.get("title"), record.get("status") or "saved"
                selection = {name: record[name] for name in
                             ("network_id", "plan_id", "campaign_id", "campaign_revision_id",
                              "frontier_id", "baseline_plan_id", "context_id", "recommendation_id") if record.get(name)}
            row = {"kind": kind, "id": key, "title": title or key[:12], "state": state,
                   "updated_at": record.get("created_at") or "", "selection": selection}
        except (ValueError, KeyError, OSError, TypeError) as error:
            row = {"kind": kind, "id": key, "title": key[:12], "state": "unreadable",
                   "updated_at": "", "error": {"type": type(error).__name__, "message": str(error)}}
        rows.append(row)
    return rows

# Sampling targets backed by original native evidence

TokenJunkieLabs · Ecosystem Sciences

Sampling now retains a completed native scientific source beside an authored monitoring target. A scientist selects an actual matched-control outcome or Terrain response source, selects one of its native quantities, and explains how the result motivates the target. The saved proposal contains that evidence with its original source edition, scientific files, spatial support, native versions, station assignment, analytical cohort and historical observation window.

The existing Sampling compiler still calculates historical date gaps, laboratory reporting-limit context, itemized planning cost and eligible historical flow episodes. Its original network, design and calendar functions remain the execution path. The native evidence accompanies those decisions through preview, saved revisions, the readable Sampling report, original-file export and editable Study transfer.

## Work in the existing application

1. Open the original completed native result. For matched controls, prepare the existing outcome report using the explicit selected control roster and quantity scope. For Terrain, use the existing completed response to prepare its scientific report source. Both operations register an ordinary source in the same Workspace.
2. Open **Sampling**, choose the saved observational context and author the programme. Select the source station, exact analytical cohort, months, historical window, visits, reporting-limit objective, rationale and costs.
3. In that target's native-evidence section, choose the original report source and one of its actual available quantities. Write the scientific applicability: what the native result suggests investigating, which field measurements would address that question, and the relevant geographic, constituent and temporal qualifications. The original free-text sensitivity context remains available independently.
4. Preview the complete proposal. Read the retained native result alongside the original observation gaps and costs. Review the exact station-to-network-to-catchment assignment and analytical metadata. The original optional field stays absent for targets that do not use a native report.
5. Save the complete proposal with the existing queue. Reopen the saved edition and inspect its retained evidence. A revision uses the original parent ID and parent digest, preserving the complete prior proposal.
6. Use the existing native design/calendar action with its explicit budget, site and scheduling configuration. The saved native result retains its original plan and the target-to-calendar comparison.
7. Export the proposal and open **sampling-review.html**. The report contains the scientist's rationale, observed target support, native quantities and links to the complete retained native reports, original CSVs, maps and source identities.
8. Export the original full Workspace or a selected editable Study rooted in the Sampling proposal. Open the received project and use its original Sampling, Monitoring, Terrain, outcomes and Sources desks.

The existing controller retains the complete pending request before queue dispatch and recovers the original task after a lost response. The Workspace and operation identity continue through that recovery. A changed target or different native source is an authored revision.

An evidence-bearing target adds one optional field to its existing selection:

Choose these values from the actual catalogue. The example strings document the shape; the application supplies the saved identifiers and available quantities.

The original proposal schema and all other target fields remain in force. There is one selected native source and one quantity per evidence-bearing target. Several targets can reference the same source while retaining different quantities, analytical cohorts or scientific rationales.

The source must be an original **OBSERVED_CONTEXT** document with an ordinary scientific report recipe. Supported producers are the existing matched-control outcomes and Terrain scientific-source modules. The resolver verifies the recipe and complete source-member inventory, the original scientific identities, the selected quantity and producing project. For same-project sources, it also reopens the original completed native result. A retained report from another project preserves that relationship explicitly.

## What the report shows

The chapter starts with the scientist's authored rationale. It then places the original source and modeled quantity alongside the target's saved station, network assignment, catchment, analytical cohort, observation dates and selected months. Each cohort metadata field retains its original state, including a missing field, explicit null, empty value and supplied value.

All displayed native numbers come from the selected original records. The renderer performs no numerical reduction, unit conversion, model execution or rounding. Zero remains zero; an unavailable native result remains unavailable. Complete JSON and native output files accompany the readable tables.

### Matched-control evidence

The report identifies the original baseline **B**, restoration **R**, and each selected matched control **C**. It displays the actual annual export quantities and the originally computed differences:

- **B−R**: modeled reduction under restoration.
- **B−C**: modeled reduction under the selected control.
- **C−R**: the directly computed restoration advantage.

The complete selected-roster common support appears first. It is the finite native intersection of the baseline, restoration and every selected control for that quantity. Individual-design support appears in a separate section; it uses the finite intersection of the baseline, restoration and that one control. Those supports retain their exact mask identity, cell count, run roster and original quantities.

The report preserves three separate area denominators for each restoration and control: whole-scenario changed hectares, changed hectares in the selected region, and changed hectares within native common support. The original normalized quantities and source-cell partitions remain attached to their original denominator and support. Exact duplicate placements and pairwise overlap stay visible.

The selection's reporting scope or model-domain scope is retained. The original model-domain geometry is the scientific spatial object. Repeated placements or deterministic cases remain their original sensitivity comparisons.

### Terrain evidence

Each Terrain row retains **alternative minus baseline** on the finite native cells shared by the baseline and every selected alternative. The report shows the joint-support baseline, alternative and direct change, common cell count and hectares, original alternative run, entered burn depth and original percentage where available.

The original baseline and alternative full-support totals are displayed with their own valid-cell counts. Pairwise cells gained or lost relative to baseline remain separately labeled. The joint-support table carries the comparison.

Annual native tables and per-pixel map legends retain their original units. Original normalized pixel mass is summed once by the existing completed response producer. Entered stream-burn depth precedes filling; the original Terrain report supplies final elevation-change, source hydrography, corridor and native-version context.

### Connecting the model to field work

The saved evidence retains the exact source-pixel export quantity and modeled geometry. The target retains its exact source station, network station, catchment assignment and laboratory cohort. Their geographic and constituent relationship is carried as a scientist-authored explanation.

Annual modeled export and the selected historical sampling window have different temporal support. Nitrogen, phosphorus and sediment outputs retain their original quantity meanings beside the observed characteristic, analytical method, fraction, speciation, unit and value type. Existing flow-scope eligibility and laboratory reporting-limit handling continue to use the original observation records.

The original Sampling priority, proposed visits, costs and dates remain explicit planning inputs. The target's scientific rationale gives readers the reason for the decision together with the retained evidence that informed it.

"""Run the complete original-source sampling programme and cold Study receiving.

Invoke inside the maintained application with explicit authored selection and
native design configuration files. This module creates no observations.

from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))

from model import monitoring_recommendations as recommendations
from model.common import atomic_json, read_json
from model.workspace import Workspace
from model import study_transfer, portable


def retain(path, value):
    atomic_json(path, value, immutable=True)


def original(path):
    body = Path(path).read_bytes()
    return {"filename": Path(path).name, "bytes": len(body),
            "sha256": hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest(),
            "text": body.decode("utf-8")}



def _report_members(workspace, recommendation_id):
    return recommendations.export_members(workspace, recommendation_id)


def _member_inventory(files):
    return [{"path": name, "bytes": member["bytes"], "sha256": member["sha256"]}
            for name, member in sorted(files.items())]


def _evidence_roster(history):
    rows = []
    for proposal in history:
        for target in proposal["targets"]:
            evidence = target.get("model_evidence")
            if evidence is None:
                continue
            native, source = evidence["native"], evidence["source"]
            rows.append({"recommendation_id": proposal["id"], "target_id": target["target_id"],
                "selection": evidence["selection"], "source": source,
                "native_family": native["family"], "native_id": native["id"],
                "native_project_id": native["project_id"],
                "run_ids": native["run_ids"], "selected_quantity": native["selected_quantity"],
                "support": native["support"], "target_binding": evidence["target_binding"],
                "relation": evidence["relation"]})
    return rows


def _required_nodes(project_id, roster):
    nodes = set()
    for row in roster:
        source = row["source"]
        nodes.add(("sources", source["collection_id"]))
        if row["native_project_id"] == project_id:
            kind = ("multivariate-control-outcomes" if row["native_family"] == "control_outcomes"
                    else "terrain-conditioning-report-sources")
            nodes.add((kind, row["native_id"]))
            for run_id in row["run_ids"]:
                nodes.add(("runs", run_id))
    return [{"kind": kind, "id": key} for kind, key in sorted(nodes)]


def _extract_report(archive_path, destination, files):
    """Open every exact packet member and retain ordinary reviewable files."""
    import os
    import shutil
    import tempfile
    import zipfile
    from model.monitoring_packet import _member_name, _verify_existing
    from model.common import file_digest
    archive_path, destination = Path(archive_path), Path(destination)
    _verify_existing(archive_path, files)
    destination.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    root = destination.resolve()
    with zipfile.ZipFile(archive_path) as archive:
        for name, member in sorted(files.items()):
            _member_name(name)
            target = destination / name
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            if not target.parent.resolve().is_relative_to(root) or target.is_symlink():
                raise ValueError("The report member left its retained receiving directory")
            if target.exists():
                if target.stat().st_size != member["bytes"] or file_digest(target) != member["sha256"]:
                    raise ValueError("Preserve the existing reviewed report file: " + name)
                continue
            temporary = None
            try:
                with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(dir=target.parent, prefix=".receiving-", delete=False) as outgoing:
                    temporary = Path(outgoing.name)
                    with archive.open(name) as incoming:
                        shutil.copyfileobj(incoming, outgoing, length=1024 * 1024)
                    outgoing.flush()
                    os.fsync(outgoing.fileno())
                if temporary.stat().st_size != member["bytes"] or file_digest(temporary) != member["sha256"]:
                    raise ValueError("The extracted original report member differs: " + name)
                os.replace(temporary, target)
                temporary = None
            finally:
                if temporary is not None:
                    temporary.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    return str(destination / "sampling-review.html")


def _verify_evidence_received(workspace, expected):
    """Execute from the received application, following original saved records."""
    if workspace.project != expected["project"]:
        raise ValueError("The received evidence belongs to another original project")
    proposal = recommendations.inspect(workspace, expected["proposal"]["id"])
    design = recommendations.inspect_design(workspace, expected["design"]["id"])
    history = recommendations.history(workspace, proposal["id"])
    if (proposal != expected["proposal"] or design != expected["design"]
            or history != expected["history"]):
        raise ValueError("The received proposal, native plan or complete original history differs")
    roster = _evidence_roster(history)
    if roster != expected["native_evidence"]:
        raise ValueError("The received source, quantity, support or target binding changed")
    # This also validates raw CAS and every selected local native dependency
    # through the unchanged original proposal and producer inspection methods.
    inventory = _member_inventory(_report_members(workspace, proposal["id"]))
    if inventory != expected["report_members"]:
        raise ValueError("Cold receiving changed the original report, CSV, source or companion bytes")
    from model import study_transfer as original_studies
    original_studies.verify_received_studies(workspace)
    return {"schema": "upstate.sampling-native-evidence-cold-receiving/v1",
        "project_id": workspace.project["id"], "proposal_id": proposal["id"],
        "design_id": design["id"], "plan_id": design["plan_id"],
        "history_ids": [r["id"] for r in history], "native_evidence": roster,
        "report_member_count": len(inventory),
        "proposal_history_equal": True, "native_records_equal": True,
        "report_member_bytes_equal": True, "rendered_inspection": False}


def _evidence_cold_main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Reopen original Sampling evidence from the received application")
    parser.add_argument("--verify-evidence-received", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--workspace", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--expected", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    result = _verify_evidence_received(Workspace(args.workspace), read_json(args.expected))
    result["application"] = str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1])
    retain(args.output, result)
    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))


def _receive_evidence(workspace, parent, configuration, args):
    """Continue the same original course with an explicitly authored child.

    The first course's sealed proposal, report and Study archive remain intact.
    A later explicit child may remove evidence while retaining its full ancestry.
    """
